mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification in development builds

The project's recorded decision is HTTPS everywhere, with no exceptions. That includes development builds: TLS certificate verification stays on in every build, dev included, and no build gets a bypass.

cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says the recorded decision is HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions. Certificate verification stays on in every build, dev included, with no bypass.

The paragraph rests on two records:
- **Decision #24, "https everywhere, no exceptions".** It is the newest decision on record.
- **Session note #21, "verification on all builds".** It supplies the dev-build wording. Decision #24 doesn't mention dev builds by name, so the dev-build part of the paragraph rests on this note.

I left out the older "verification disabled in dev builds" note (#20) and the "plain http for internal hosts" note (#22). Both conflict with "no exceptions", and neither is a recorded decision, so the doc doesn't mention either.

The first attempt to write the file through the shell failed with a parser error. I created it with the Write tool instead.
